content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in early forecast periods, especially after recent spikes; adjust downward by 1–3% for the first 5–7 days.
- Overestimates prices after sharp upward moves (e.g., post-70+ spikes); reduce forecast by 2–5% for the next 3–5 days.
- Tends to overreact to recent volatility; apply mean reversion bias: if 30-day moving average is >70, reduce forecast by 1–2% for next 5 days.
- Underestimates prices in late forecast horizon (last 5–7 days); add 0.5–1.5% to forecast for final 7 days if true values are trending upward.
- Forecast lags true values by 1–3 days in most cases; shift forecast 1–2 days forward for next 30-day window.
- Avoid overfitting to recent low prices; if last 5 days are below 65, don’t assume trend reversal; maintain 1–2% buffer above recent low.
